steps.title: Inject mice with 5-FC and thymine
steps.instruction: On day 31, inject each mouse intraperitoneally with 250 mg per kg body weight of 5‑fluorocytosine (5‑FC) prepared in PBS (12.5 µg ml⁻¹ stock) and inject subcutaneously with 125 mg per kg body weight of thymine prepared in PBS (6.25 µg ml⁻¹ stock).

substeps.instruction: Inject 250 mg/kg 5‑FC intraperitoneally using PBS (12.5 µg/ml stock).
Inject 125 mg/kg thymine subcutaneously using PBS (6.25 µg/ml stock).
